text:
maria: Hey folks — opened a docs PR for the on-prem installer. It includes containerd private registry config, a systemd unit example, an HSM/PKCS11 env snippet, and air-gapped registry notes. Need a quick accuracy pass on the network steps before I merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321
sam: Linking in now. Quick scan — will check iptables ordering and the containerd section.
olivia: skimmed the containerd file. There's a small typo: uses `registry.mirror` but containerd uses `registry.mirrors` (plural). Also cert-rotation script references `/etc/redwood/certs/rotate.sh` but the systemd unit expects `/usr/local/bin/redwood-rotate-certs`. Pick one.
ram: Networking nit: the NAT rules in the doc might drop returning traffic if FORWARD ordering is wrong. Suggest the example rules show conntrack accept first, then NAT: `-A FORWARD -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT` then `-A FORWARD -s 10.42.0.0/16 -j ACCEPT` then NAT `-t nat -A POSTROUTING -s 10.42.0.0/16 -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE`.
sam: also add `sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1` and note persistent sysctl in `/etc/sysctl.d/99-redwood.conf`. And mention `net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max` for high-concurrency clusters.
maria: good catches. On the HSM bit I added `PKCS11_PROVIDER=/opt/hsm/libpkcs11.so` but docs-linter complained about hardcoded `/opt`. Where do we prefer installing provider libs in our distro packaging?
olivia: packaging convention: Debian -> `/usr/lib/redwood/hsm/`, RPM -> `/opt/redwood/hsm/`. Best to show both and use a template var `{{ hsm_provider_path }}` in the installer guide.
ram: SDK examples — we should show a tiny Python and Go snippet for using PKCS11 provider. Python idea: `from redwood import Client
client = Client(kms_provider='pkcs11', pkcs11_lib='/usr/lib/redwood/hsm/libpkcs11.so')
print(client.kms.list_keys())` Put it in the "SDK snippets" section.
maria: will add the Go snippet and a migration note: customers migrating from soft-kms must rewrap keys with the HSM. I referenced `migrations/rewrap-keys.sh` but it's only a placeholder. Need somebody to add a real example rewrap script.
doc-bot: docs-linter: 3 warnings, 1 error. Error: broken anchor in `networking.md` line 78 (link to `#firewall-flow` missing). See CI: https://ci.internal.redwood/docs/4321
sam: I'll patch the anchor and add a tiny ascii firewall flow diagram. Also will add a short changelog entry under `docs/whats-new.md`.
olivia: nice. If you can add the RPM/Deb packaging path examples for the PKCS11 lib and make the env var configurable, I can approve the content side. Also include a short note about HSM permission bits (chown root:root, chmod 440) and selinux label tips.
maria: pushed updates: added `containerd.tmpl`, `systemd/redwood-inference.service`, ascii net diagram, both HSM paths, and a python + go SDK snippet. Updated PR description and changed cert-rotate path to `/usr/local/bin/redwood-rotate-certs` for consistency. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321
ram: reviewed, left one nit: change "open port 50051" -> "open management port 50051 internally only (don't expose publicly)".
maria: fixed that wording and pushed. Thanks everyone — will merge once doc-bot is green.
doc-bot: docs-linter: all checks passed. PR merged by maria (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/8a9d5f3)
